metadata.description: Digital Republic plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: spek
plugins.description: Spec-driven development for Claude Code, built for the code you already have: extract a baseline from existing code, specify with explicit scope boundaries, plan, break into tasks, implement and verify against both the spec and the baseline. Greenfield flow fully supported.

plugins.name: c4-codebase
plugins.description: Reverse-engineers an existing codebase into evidence-backed architecture documentation and a canonical C4 Structurizr DSL model, with resumable state across sessions. Skill only.

plugins.name: fleet
plugins.description: Orchestrates worker Claude Code teammates in split panes: the lead session spawns workers, dispatches manual tasks or the items of a Markdown task plan (.claude/fleet/tasks/<name>.md, with dependencies and agent types) to them, collects their results and draws a live status pane. Ships two skills: task-plan (split a goal into parallel items) and orchestrate (run and supervise a plan).

plugins.name: tsc-report
plugins.description: Runs the TypeScript type checker (the project's typecheck script, tsc or tsc -b), saves the raw output and two grouped JSON reports (by error code and by file) to ./tsc-reports/<timestamp>/, and answers with tables plus one paragraph that assesses the current state and recommends the first action. Detects multiple tsconfigs and workspaces. Skill only.

plugins.name: brainstorm-ideias
plugins.description: Ideation facilitator backed by a research base of 40+ brainstorming and innovation methods (How Might We, SCAMPER, TRIZ, inversion, premortem, biomimicry, JTBD, Blue Ocean, Lean Canvas and more): runs sessions on the user's problem with separate divergence and convergence, or explains a technique with a worked example. Skill only.

plugins.name: cloudflare-static-publish
plugins.description: Publishes static sites on Cloudflare with Workers Static Assets or Pages: generates wrangler.jsonc, a manual deploy script and an optional GitHub Actions workflow (or guides the native Git integration), protects the site with Cloudflare Access One-time PIN, and sets up custom domain DNS on Cloudflare zones or external providers. Every Cloudflare change is planned first and applied only after confirmation. Skill only.

plugins.name: open-questions
plugins.description: Publishes the open questions of the current work (gaps, assumptions to confirm, decisions, items to approve) as an interactive claude.ai Artifact: one question at a time with its context, controls that fit each item type, answers saved for Claude to read back, and owners so another person can answer their part. Focuses on the design and usability of the page. Skill only.
